context_requirements: Expression of functional HCRTR1 and/or HCRTR2 on the cell surface
An orexin-responsive signaling context, typically neuronal or neuroendocrine
Presence of downstream orexin signaling components (e.g., Gq-coupled calcium mobilization machinery)
falsifiers: Reproducible, dose-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
A shared transcriptional signature across multiple cell lines that is absent in vehicle controls
Evidence of HCRTR1 or HCRTR2 expression and signaling in these cell lines

evidence.supports: Dual orexin receptor antagonist treatment altered noradrenalin transporter/monoamine oxidase A mRNA in mouse hippocampus, indicating transcriptional effects in brain, not in the tested peripheral human cell lines.
